name: intel_portfolio_assumptions
status: expert assumptions: not estimated from the bank's data; to be confirmed and moved to the Deal Desk parameter tables

sale_discount_by_bucket.basis: Secondary-market price discount to par by rating bucket (expert; the bank has no loan-sale history in Data Domains)

deposit_spread.basis: Annual value of relationship deposits as a spread over FTP (expert; deposits domain carries balances, not their FTP credit)

commitment_fee.basis: Annual commitment fee on undrawn limits (expert; origination carries upfront fees only)

renewal_window_months.basis: Not-renew applies to facilities whose annual review or maturity falls in the next 6 months

sell_down_min_ead_sar_mn.basis: Smallest obligor exposure a syndication or participation desk would place

sell_down_share.basis: Share sold in a sell-down (participation or secondary sale)

unused_utilisation_max.basis: An undrawn commitment is unused when the peak utilisation of the last 4 quarters is at most 60% (at least 40% of the limit not used in a year); the book's lowest peaks are about 45%

unused_buffer.basis: Limit kept at the 4-quarter peak drawn plus 10%

ucc_ccf.basis: CCF for unconditionally cancellable commitments (Basel III CRE20.95; confirm SAMA's adoption)

sme_revenue_max_sar_mn.basis: SME corporate: annual turnover up to SAR 200m (confirm against SAMA's SME definition in force)

sme_rw.basis: SAMA Basel III SA: SME corporate risk weight 85% (sa_risk_weights.sme_corporate)

defaulted_rw_provisioned.basis: Basel III SA CRE20.88: defaulted exposure 100% when specific provisions are at least 20% of the outstanding, else 150%

legal_years.basis: Time from filing to collateral realisation in KSA enforcement courts (expert)

legal_cost_pct.basis: Legal and enforcement cost as a share of the amount recovered (expert)

forced_sale_haircut_extra.basis: Extra haircut on collateral realised through enforcement over the LGD haircut (expert)

reschedule_cure_prob.basis: Probability a distressed reschedule cures within 12 months by restructuring count (expert; col_restructured holds only 12 cured cases)

unsecured_recovery_legal.basis: Share of the unsecured balance recovered through legal action (expert; the book has few resolved defaults)

reschedule_concession_pct.basis: NPV given up by extending tenor or cutting margin in a reschedule, as a share of EAD (expert)

extra_collateral_cover.basis: Extra collateral asked in a workout, as a share of EAD, at the real-estate haircut

partial_exit_share.basis: Share of EAD repaid or cancelled in a negotiated partial exit

partial_exit_cost_pct.basis: Concession given to secure a partial exit (fees waived, margin) as a share of the amount repaid
